info.name: Mana Yantram · Milestones 1 to 3
info.description: Use the local environment and Postman's cookie jar. Register or log in first: the bearer token is stored in `accessToken`. Requests are grouped by area and chain through environment variables (`fileId`, `providerId`, `equipmentId`, ...) that earlier requests fill in, so run each folder top to bottom. Department folders (Accounts and users, Verification) need a department login whose role has the noted permission. Every write sends X-CSRF-Protection: 1.

item.name: Masters

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('districtId', data[0].id); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('mandalId', data[0].id); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('villageId', data[0].id); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; const tractor = data.find((c) => c.code === 'TRACTOR'); pm.environment.set('categoryId', tractor.id); pm.environment.set('operationId', tractor.operations.find((o) => o.code === 'PLOUGHING').id); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('cropId', data.find((c) => c.code === 'PADDY').id); }

item.description: Public lookups. Run these first: they fill districtId, mandalId, villageId, categoryId, operationId and cropId.

item.name: Add the provider role to my account

request.description: Farmer and provider accounts only; department and operator accounts get 403 ROLE_NOT_GRANTABLE.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('userId', data.id); }

request.description: Pick a PDF, JPEG or PNG in the file field. The returned id is then sent in a JSON body (step 2).

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('fileId', data.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('photoFileId', data.id); }

item.name: Farmer

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('plotId', data.id); }

item.description: Log in as a farmer. The Aadhaar number is optional on the profile and is never returned.

item.name: Assisted registration

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('farmerId', data.id); }

item.description: Log in as a field agent or helpdesk user. The farmer must change the temporary password at first sign-in.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('providerId', data.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('documentId', (data.find((d) => d.document) || {document: {}}).document.id); }

item.description: Log in as a provider. Submitting needs every checklist item done; returned items must be replaced before resubmitting.

item.name: Equipment

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('equipmentId', data.id); pm.environment.set('unitId', data.units[0].id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('serviceId', data.id); }

item.description: Money is integer paise (rupees x 100). Upload a photo first so photoFileId is set.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('blockId', data.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('operatorId', data.id); }

request.description: Log in as the operator (after changing the temporary password).

item.name: Verification (officer)

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('providerId', data.items.length ? data.items[0].id : pm.environment.get('providerId')); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('documentId', (data.documents.find((d) => d.document) || {document: {}}).document.id); }

item.description: Log in as a district officer or administrator. Approve needs every required document and the bank account accepted.

item.name: Rate caps

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('rateCapId', data.id); }

item.name: As a provider: the cap for my district

item.description: Optional maximum rates. Enforcement is off until switched on. Use a state or super admin login (settings.manage); the last request needs a provider login.
